correctness.rationale: The circle degree is 1 and angular speed has denominator D_a D_b>0 and exact quadratic numerator N=4abx²−4b(1+ab)x+1−a²+3b²+a²b² in x=cos t. Independent sympy algebra verified this numerator, both boundary factorizations and vertex value N(x0)=(a−b)(1−a²−ab+a²b²)/a. If ab≤0 the quadratic is concave/affine; if ab>0 vertex x0=(1+ab)/(2a) matters only inside the endpoint strip and has discriminant a²(4a²−3), giving the claimed r± forbidden interval and critical tip. Analytic nonnegative lift derivative with degree one implies strict topological increase even at isolated zero contacts; strictly positive derivative is necessary for a C-infinity inverse. Opposite-sign endpoint N yields exactly one interior cosine root and two angular folds; interior negative convex minimum with positive endpoints yields two roots/four folds. Independent exact witness a=9/10,b=1/2 has N(29/36)=−23/900 and positive diametral values. Classical Radó–Kneser–Choquet supplies the disk Poisson extension, not a new convolution theorem.

originality.rationale: Wang–Zhong use exactly this rational Blaschke quotient only at a fixed rational pair and show its boundary positivity en route to an unrelated harmonic-convolution counterexample. The full two-real-parameter disconnected admissibility band, cusp and fold counts do not follow from their fixed-pair positivity test. Other indexed same-ray results concern convolution Jacobians, not the boundary map across all pairs.
residual_risks: An unindexed analytic treatment of the exact two-parameter rational Blaschke boundary monotonicity region could contain an equivalent inequality.
No assertion about injectivity outside |z|=1 or self-convolution is supported.

final_claim: For real a,b in (−1,1), the real Blaschke quotient Gamma(z)=z B_a(z)/B_b(z) is an orientation-preserving circle homeomorphism on the exact endpoint strip L(a)≤b≤U(a) with a same-sign forbidden interior band above |a|=sqrt(3)/2; the strict inequalities and closed band exclusion characterize smooth diffeomorphisms, with two- and four-turning-point regions and classical harmonic Poisson extension.
limitations: Strictly real |a|,|b|<1; not complex Blaschke parameters or general quotient rational functions.
Equality boundaries are homeomorphisms, not smooth diffeomorphisms; RKC implication is classical.
residual_risks: An unindexed analytic treatment of the exact two-parameter rational Blaschke boundary monotonicity region could contain an equivalent inequality.
No assertion about injectivity outside |z|=1 or self-convolution is supported.
